newsitem.title: UK: Open Systems Holdings to seek AIM listing.
newsitem.headline: Open Systems Holdings to seek AIM listing.

text.p: Open Systems Holdings Plc said on Monday it planned to list on the London Stock Exchange's Alternative Investment Market (AIM) via an institutional placing valuing it at between 8.0 million stg and 10.0 million.
The placing will raise between 2.0 and 3.0 million stg for the U.S-based accounting software developer and distributor, which said it would be the first U.S. company to be listed on AIM.
The proceeds of the float, with Butterfield Securities as both broker and adviser, will finance the launch in the UK of the company's Windows-based accounting software products.
"We are now in a position to launch our products into the UK market place, which we believe is more than ready for change," said chief executive Michael Bertini.
"Our flotation on AIM will give us the financial backing and public profile to capitalise on these opportunities, both in the U.K and further afield."
In the U.K Open Systems will trade under the name Traverse Software Ltd. First dealings in the shares are scheduled for early February.
